test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question: Which of the following is the correct description of the place called ‘Naubat Khana’ during the Mughal period?

options.text: Office of the security-in-charge of the palace

solution:
The correct answer is __**Drum house.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• During festivities, **a drum house or orchestra pit **is referred to as a **Naqqar Khana or Naubat Khana.**
 
• The name simply translates to "drum (Naqqar/Naubat)-hous
